title: 第二十四章 收点利息第二十五章 小蝴蝶
content_zh:
虽然被踢飞两次，身子都快被摔的散架了，李春生全然不记仇，主动的伸出手向林昆自我介绍道：“你好，我叫李春生，是苏有朋的舅舅。”
林昆模仿着李春生的套路，也做了个简单的自我介绍，然后随便聊了几句，林昆这才知道苏有朋是今天才转学过来的，以前在燕京读书。
苏有朋这孩子看上去很精致，白胖白胖的像个陶瓷娃娃，虽然名字和著名演员苏有朋一样，但长相和气质完全不同，除非苏有朋小时候很胖也很内向。
跟冯佳慧、李春生、苏有朋告别完，林昆抱着小楚澄朝卡罗拉走去，路上小家伙凑在林昆的耳边小声的说：“爸爸，我刚才发现了个秘密。”
“哦？”
“冯老师跟你说话脸红了，我猜她一定是喜欢你，你可得把持住了。”
“……”林昆脑门上立马垂下来三道黑线，“小孩子别瞎说，你冯老师刚才脸红，是因为她自己不小心说了让自己脸红的话，不是喜欢爸爸。”
“是么？”小楚澄一副怀疑的表情看着林昆，“爸爸，你可不准骗小孩子哦。”
林昆抬起手指头在小家伙的脑门上爱昵的摁了一下，“放心吧，不会的。”
父子俩来到了卡罗拉车前，小楚澄从林昆怀里下来后，就扑向了楚静瑶，关心的连连问道：“妈妈，妈妈你的脚没事吧，疼不疼啊，我给你揉揉。”
楚静瑶开心的把小楚澄抱在怀里，在他的脸蛋上亲了两下，道：“宝贝，放心吧，妈妈的脚没事，已经不怎么疼了，回家休养一下就好了。”
小楚澄搂着楚静瑶的脖子，脸蛋贴在妈妈的脸上磨蹭着，“妈妈，我今天考100分了，还和苏有朋交朋友了。”
“谁！？”楚静瑶惊惑的问。
“苏有朋呀。”
“是澄澄他们班新转来的一个同学，名字和苏有朋一模一样，不是演电影的那个苏有朋，两个差三十多岁呢。”林昆发动了车子，回过头道。
“哦……”
楚静瑶明白了，笑着摸着小楚澄的脑袋道：“我的澄澄真棒，都考100分了呢，以后再接再厉，好好保持。”
“妈妈，我考100分了，有没有奖励呀？”
“当然有了，澄澄想要什么奖励？”
“想要……”小家伙嘬着手指头想了想，然后说：“妈妈，你先答应我可以么？”

楚静瑶故意摆出一副考虑的表情，小楚澄马上摇着她的胳膊，小孩子撒娇的道：“妈妈……妈妈你就先答应我吧……”
楚静瑶笑着道：“好好好，妈妈先答应你，你说你想要什么礼物吧。”
小楚澄摇头，“澄澄不要礼物，澄澄今天晚上还要和爸爸妈妈一起睡。”
楚静瑶脸上的表情顿时一僵，已经答应孩子了，话就不能再收回了，她摸着小楚澄的脸蛋笑着说没问题，眼神却不经意的瞥向林昆，她怀疑这是林昆教儿子说的，否则儿子应该会要一套新的玩具或者连环画之类的。
“哼，这个流氓！”楚静瑶在心里暗暗咬牙道。
林昆这可真是被冤枉了，啥叫躺着中枪，他这就是活生生的例子啊。
卡罗拉开进了别墅区，停在七号别墅的大门口，小楚澄蹦蹦跳跳的从车上下来，楚静瑶扭伤的那只脚不敢着地，最后还得让林昆抱她回去。
林昆奸佞的一笑，站在车门前对楚静瑶说：“老婆，这次可是你让我抱你的……”
楚静瑶看了一眼已经跑到家门口的小楚澄，回过头来狠狠的剐了林昆一眼，压低声音警告道：“你要是再敢占我便宜，小心我要你好看！”
“哦？哈哈……”林昆大笑两声，躬身把楚静瑶从车里抱出来，故意皱了皱眉头，然后一副考究的表情对楚静瑶说：“老婆，你还真不轻啊，是不是该减肥了？”
“你……”
楚静瑶轻咬贝齿，心里暗恨道：“这混蛋怎么知道自己最近重了两斤？”
content_en:
Although he was kicked twice and his body was almost falling apart, Li Chunsheng did not hold any grudge at all. He took the initiative to reach out and introduce himself to Lin Kun: "Hello, my name is Li Chunsheng, and I am Su Youpeng's uncle."
Lin Kun imitated Li Chunsheng's routine and made a brief self-introduction, and then chatted for a few words. Lin Kun then learned that Su Youpeng had just transferred here today and had studied in Yanjing before.
Su Youpeng looks very delicate, white and plump like a porcelain doll. Although his name is the same as the famous actor Su Youpeng, his appearance and temperament are completely different, unless Su Youpeng was very fat and introverted when he was a child.
After saying goodbye to Feng Jiahui, Li Chunsheng, and Su Youpeng, Lin Kun carried little Chu Cheng and walked toward Corolla. On the way, the little guy whispered in Lin Kun's ear: "Dad, I just discovered a secret."
"Oh?"
"Teacher Feng blushes when she talks to you. I guess she must like you. You have to control it."
"..." Three black lines immediately hung down from Lin Kun's forehead, "Kid, don't talk nonsense, your teacher Feng blushed just now because she accidentally said something that made her blush, not because she likes dad."
"Really?" Xiao Chucheng looked at Lin Kun with a suspicious expression, "Dad, you are not allowed to lie to children."
Lin Kun raised his finger and pressed lovingly on the little guy's forehead, "Don't worry, it won't happen."
The father and son came to the Corolla. After little Chu Cheng got off Lin Kun's arms, he threw himself at Chu Jingyao and asked with concern: "Mom, is your foot okay? Does it hurt? I'll rub it for you."
Chu Jingyao happily held little Chu Cheng in her arms, kissed him twice on the face, and said: "Baby, don't worry, mom's foot is fine, it doesn't hurt much anymore, just go home and rest for a while."
Little Chu Cheng put her arms around Chu Jingyao's neck and rubbed her face against her mother's, "Mom, I scored 100 points in the test today, and I even made friends with Su Youpeng."
"Who!?" Chu Jingyao asked in surprise.
"Su Youpeng."
"It's a new classmate from Chengcheng's class. His name is exactly the same as Su Youpeng. He's not the Su Youpeng who acted in the movie. They are about thirty years apart." Lin Kun started the car and turned around and said.
"Oh..."
Chu Jingyao understood, smiled and touched little Chu Cheng's head and said: "My Chengcheng is really good. She even got 100 points in the test. I will continue to work hard in the future and keep up the good work."
"Mom, I got 100 points in the exam, is there any reward?"
"Of course, what reward does Chengcheng want?"
"I want to..." The little guy licked his fingers and thought for a while, then said, "Mom, can you promise me first?"
Chu Jingyao deliberately put on a considerate expression, and little Chu Cheng immediately shook her arm, and the child said coquettishly: "Mom...Mom, just promise me first..."
Chu Jingyao smiled and said: "Okay, okay, mom promises you first, tell me what gift you want."
Little Chucheng shook his head, "Chengcheng doesn't want a gift, Chengcheng has to sleep with his parents tonight."
The expression on Chu Jingyao's face suddenly froze. She had already promised her child, and she could not take it back. She touched little Chu Cheng's face and said with a smile that it was okay, but her eyes inadvertently glanced at Lin Kun. She suspected that this was what Lin Kun taught his son, otherwise his son would have asked for a new set of toys or comics.
"Humph, this gangster!" Chu Jingyao gritted her teeth secretly in her heart.
Lin Kun was really wronged. He was a living example of what it meant to be shot while lying down.
Carolla entered the villa area and stopped at the gate of Villa No. 7. Little Chu Cheng jumped out of the car. Chu Jingyao's sprained foot did not dare to touch the ground. In the end, she had to let Lin Kun carry her back.
Lin Kun smiled slyly, stood in front of the car door and said to Chu Jingyao: "Honey, you asked me to hug you this time..."
Chu Jingyao took one look and ran to the door of her house.Little Chu Cheng turned around and gave Lin Kun a hard look, lowering his voice and warning: "If you dare to take advantage of me again, be careful because I want you to look good!"
"Oh? Haha..." Lin Kun laughed twice, bowed and took Chu Jingyao out of the car, frowned deliberately, and then said to Chu Jingyao with a sophisticated expression: "Honey, you are really not light. Is it time to lose weight?"
"You..."
Chu Jingyao bit her teeth lightly and said secretly: "How does this bastard know that he has gained two pounds recently?"
